notes: Repairs a production-observed FR-08 evidence relevance defect where ambiguous Idea wording caused OpenAlex/Crossref results from unrelated management/government domains to enter the Research dossier.
Adds deterministic Idea/evidence relevance gating before model synthesis so agents cannot convert clearly off-topic retrieval into authoritative Research.
Adds a focused scholarly query derived only from the user Idea; Brand Brain/private Brand context is not sent into global-public scholarly search.
Research fails safely without persistence when too little relevant evidence remains.
No new provider, agent authority, publishing authority, database schema, infrastructure or release workflow is introduced.

approvals.rationale: Owner said 'Fix' immediately after reviewing the production Research dossier containing two clearly off-topic Claims and one weak motorcycle-mod Claim. Scope is bounded to restoring FR-08 evidence relevance and regression-verifying FR-09 grounding.

This correction strengthens the approved evidence-before-confident-claims and FR-08 factuality controls without adding data sources, agent/tool authority, privacy scope, publishing authority or retention policy.

Owner explicitly instructed the diagnosed research-quality defect to be fixed. This authorises bounded branch implementation, tests and verification only; it does not authorise certification, merge, release, production enablement or deployment.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Research dossiers contain evidence that is materially relevant to the user's Idea, and the workflow fails safely rather than persisting unrelated Claims when relevant evidence is insufficient.
metrics: Researcher invocation success on relevant evidence
